root_causes: Race conditions causing shared resource corruption or invalid state
Improper handling or locking of critical sections in concurrency scenarios
Resource exhaustion such as thread pool starvation or database connection limits
Uncaught exceptions in concurrent request handling code paths
Inadequate validation or sanitization leading to inconsistent states under load
key_constraints: Limited thread or connection pool sizes which can be exhausted under concurrency
Atomicity requirements on shared data modifications
Timeouts and latency constraints for API responses
Dependency on external systems that may also bottleneck under concurrency
Ensuring backward compatibility and minimal impact to existing clients
strategy: Perform thorough concurrency testing and code review focusing on shared state handling and synchronization. Add logging and monitoring to capture contextual data during 500 errors. Implement thread-safe resource management and safeguard critical sections with appropriate locks or atomic operations. Increase resource limits if needed and apply backpressure or request throttling. Ensure proper exception handling paths to prevent uncaught exceptions. Validate all inputs consistently and consider adopting idempotent operations to handle retries gracefully.
